textos.texto: On Monday morning Ana does not feel well. Her head hurts and she has a fever: thirty-nine degrees. She has a cough too, and her body is very tired. She must not go to work today, so she does not go out. Laura makes a hot soup for her and she buys medicine in the pharmacy near the house. The medicine is for the fever and for the headache. Ana has a cold: her nose and her mouth are not well, and her neck hurts. In the afternoon her stomach hurts too, because she does not eat anything in the morning. She must eat and she must drink much water. On Tuesday she is not sick: her head does not hurt and there is no fever. But her back hurts, because she is in bed all the day. On Wednesday Ana is healthy again and she goes to work. Her doctor is happy: Ana must sleep eight hours and eat vegetables every day.

textos.texto: Paul goes to the hospital, because his stomach hurts every day after lunch. A nurse is with him first: he does not have a fever and he is not sick. Then the doctor visits him. Where is the pain? The pain is in the stomach, under the heart, and sometimes in the back. Paul does not have a cough and his head does not hurt. Does he eat vegetables? Does he sleep well? Paul eats a lot of meat and he sleeps five hours. That is the problem. He must eat fruit and vegetables, he must drink much water and he must sleep eight hours. The doctor also has medicine for the pain: one in the morning and one at night. Paul does not have an allergy, so the medicine is good for him. After two weeks Paul feels well and he is healthy again. Now he goes to the hospital only one time in the year.

textos.texto: Ana is a healthy student. Every morning she brushes her teeth and she cleans her hands. She has breakfast and then she walks for thirty minutes: her legs and her feet are strong. She never has a pain in her knees. Her eyes are not tired, because she does not read in the night, and her ears are well: she listens to music for one hour, not more. Ana eats fruit and vegetables every day, and she drinks much water, so her stomach is well. She does not have an allergy. In winter many friends have a cold, with a cough and a fever, but Ana is not sick: she sleeps eight hours every night and her body is healthy. When her head hurts she does not take medicine: she rests one hour in her bedroom. Sometimes her back and her shoulders hurt, because she reads with the computer on her legs. So she must read with the computer on a table. Now her back is well and her arms do not hurt. One finger hurts sometimes, but it is not a big pain.

textos.texto: On Saturday Paul is on his bike in the park. On the road there is water, and after the corner Paul is on the floor with his bike. His arm hurts and there is a big pain in his knee. His leg is not well and he can not walk. A friend takes his phone and an ambulance comes in ten minutes. In the hospital a nurse cleans his arm and his hand. The doctor visits his leg and his knee: there is not a big problem, but Paul must rest for two weeks. He must not take his bike and he must not run. The doctor has medicine for the pain: two in the day. Paul does not have a fever and his head is well: he is not sick, only tired. His mother is in the hospital at six with a hot soup. After two weeks his knee does not hurt and his arm is well. Now Paul is healthy again.

textos.titulo: Examen · Marie no se siente bien
textos.texto: On Thursday Marie does not feel well. Her head hurts and she has a fever: thirty-eight degrees. She has a cough and her neck hurts too. She must not go to work, so she is in bed all the morning. Her sister buys medicine in the pharmacy near the house: one for the fever and one for the headache. Marie does not have an allergy, so the medicine is good for her. In the afternoon her stomach hurts, because she does not eat anything. Her sister makes a hot soup and Marie must drink much water. On Friday there is no fever, but her back and her legs hurt, because she is in bed all the day. She does not need an ambulance and she does not go to the hospital. On Saturday Marie feels well: her body is healthy again and she goes out with her sister.
